Entire composition occupies about 62% canvas width and stays low with generous clear margins. Soft late-afternoon side light and delicate diffused shadows, luxurious calm editorial macro photography; palette warm ivory, golden ochre, muted olive, pale honey. No tree landscape, no birch, no berries or flowers, no vase, no ribbon, no paper craft, no jewelry, no faces or characters, no phone frame, no UI, no lettering or watermark.
